description:
CENSUS COMPLETE (2026-08-31). Recipe: fz2 interp debug at 84ae179b4, three
target fixtures; stream classification (applied events) + direction probes at
the three define sites (ReturnType join path, CallSiteMap::define,
define_activation_analysis pointwise value_types), probes reverted.

## The table (non-initial AnalyzeActivation evaluations)

fixture         non-init  zero-chg  pure-ascent  no-ascent  mixed  no-data
take_drop            798  192 (24%)   293 (37%)  183 (23%)  129 (16%)  1
range_map            229   85 (37%)    87 (38%)   44 (19%)   11 (5%)   2
predicate            631  171 (27%)   294 (47%)   94 (15%)   69 (11%)  3

CHURN = zero-change + no-ascent [+ mixed]: 47%/63%, 56%/61%, 42%/53%.
Store-level directions: CallSiteSummary ascent 354/99/318, lateral 218/14/100
(laterals = target-key swaps, the migration echo), narrow 0; ActivationAnalyzed
ascent 398/94/349, lateral 124/44/72, narrow 3/2/0.

## Two discoveries beyond the rule

1. ReturnType facts NO LONGER ASCEND IN PLACE: zero join-path content changes
   on all three fixtures (post kdt.63/69, the ascent expresses as
   CallSiteSummary/ActivationAnalyzed joins plus key migration; per-key
   returns publish ~once).
2. THE ASCENT IS SHALLOW, NOT TALL: ~2 ascent steps per moving fact
   (354 ascents over ~171 moving CallSiteSummary facts). The
   widening-ladder-compression lever has near-zero headroom -- you cannot
   usefully compress a 2-step ascent.

## VERDICT (pre-registered rule applied honestly)

Strict count (zero+no-ascent): 47/56/42 -- one fixture crosses 50%. Counting
mixed evals (which contain non-ascent movement a perfect classifier would
not re-derive): 63/61/53 -- ALL cross. Combined with discovery 2 (the
alternative campaign has no headroom), the indicated campaign is WAKE
PRECISION / CHANGE CLASSIFICATION: roughly half the analysis work re-derives
conclusions its waking movements could not change (zero-change re-runs woken
chiefly by ReturnType 121/42/134 and FunctionContract 65/30/33 movements)
or re-derives laterally (migration echoes).

Note for fz-kdt.74's re-entry condition 4: the census SPLITS -- much of the
lateral churn IS identity-migration echo, but the dominant single class is
zero-change re-runs, which no identity re-plumbing fixes. Cells stay
refuted; the wake-precision campaign proceeds first.

## Known hazard for the next campaign (from this census's own dig)
Subsumption-gated wakes on the WHOLE eval are unsound: only the return fold
is a pure join; value_types and callsite summaries consume moved inputs
directly. Any gating must be per-OUTPUT (the fz-kdt.13.1 derivation
substrate / parked 13.2 machinery is the natural granularity). Design ground
-- full treatment (dig, cold proposal, integrate) before building.
title: Ascent census: classify the 79% -- genuine ascent vs zero-change churn vs rebase oscillation
